100 GRID · CRAFT · CARE ABOUT EVERY DETAIL
Craft is the value of finishing: every scale looked after, including the ones nobody checks.
The 100 note is a carpet divided by three, three times. The shape of the hole alternates with every scale, so no
level repeats the one above it. The same rule lays out the whole note: a sample sheet of nine finished cells.
3 × 3 × 3 subdivision: 1 circle, 8 squares, 64 circles. 73 holes, 512 solid cells.
The hole alternates with every scale, so no level imitates the one above.
The right side is a 3 × 3 sheet, cells 292 × 200, numerals across the middle row.
The carpet repeats at one third scale inside its own centre: craft within craft.
Rulers on the carpet carry ticks at 27, 9 and 3 divisions, longest at the thirds.
FLAT-COLOUR SEPARATION · ONE PLATE PER ROLE
